title: Paxos partner film
description: A small co-brand lockup (two wordmarks split by a thin vertical rule) over a centred two-line 48px title and a wide 16:9-ish film frame (992×565, 8px corners). On phones the lockup and title go left and the film fills the width. Static; the film slot takes a real video.
notes: the empty film frame is a dark slate surface with a round play button
